definition: QQ Bangs are equipment created at the Clothing Mixing Shop that replace the stat effects normally provided by worn clothing.
core_rules: QQ Bangs override clothing attribute boosts/debuffs.
Each QQ Bang modifies the six main clothing-related attributes independently.
QQ Bangs are crafted through the Clothing Mixing Shop at Capsule Corporation via the Transfer Shop Clerk.
next_reconciliation: Populate the QQ Bang records with normalized stat vectors, star rating, recipes, materials, and reproducible crafting notes.
